text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
No, thanks to you, Trainer,
I understand just how difficult it is to obtain.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...How about selling
Machan dolls in the North Pole?"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It seems that when something is hard to obtain, the desire to acquire it grows even stronger.
Let's keep this idea warm for later.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
